acceptance_criteria: AC-1: GET /api/v1/questions paginated list with all filter params, 401 on unauth
AC-2: POST /api/v1/questions creates draft, type-specific validation, 422 per-field errors
AC-3: GET /api/v1/questions/:id full detail with translations, options, tags, locale_coverage, 404
AC-4: PUT /api/v1/questions/:id in-place for draft/review, auto-versioning (serializable tx) for active
AC-5: POST /api/v1/questions/:id/status state machine, 422 ERR_INVALID_TRANSITION, 400 on missing stem
AC-7: GET /api/v1/questions/:id/versions oldest-first chain, data.versions shape
AC-8: POST/DELETE /api/v1/questions/:id/tags, 404 bad tag, idempotent add
AC-9: audit_log entry for every mutating endpoint
